name: Chicken Liver
siboNotes: Generally well-tolerated as it's naturally FODMAP-free. High protein content may support gut healing in SIBO recovery.
preparationTips: Soak in milk for 30 minutes before cooking to reduce strong flavor
Cook quickly over high heat to maintain tender texture
Season with FODMAP-friendly herbs like thyme, oregano, or chives
Avoid onion and garlic - use garlic-infused oil instead
nutritionalHighlights: Extremely high in vitamin A and iron
Rich in vitamin B12 and folate
Good source of CoQ10 and choline
